title: Experimental estimators gated by module __getattr__ must not be listed in __all__
answers: star import of model_selection fails mentioning enable_halving_search_cv
how to expose experimental estimator to type checkers without breaking import *
body:
Symptom: `from sklearn.model_selection import *` raises ImportError asking to import `sklearn.experimental.enable_halving_search_cv`.
Root cause: sklearn/model_selection/__init__.py listed HalvingGridSearchCV/HalvingRandomSearchCV in `__all__`, but the module `__getattr__` raises ImportError for them until the experimental enabler is imported; `import *` resolves every name in `__all__`.
Fix pattern: keep experimental (enabler-gated) names OUT of `__all__`; for type checkers, import them only under `if typing.TYPE_CHECKING:` with `# noqa: F401` (the noqa is needed because the name is no longer referenced by `__all__`).
Constraints: applies to any subpackage whose `__getattr__` guards experimental names (e.g. halving search, and similarly gated estimators); explicit access must still raise the guidance error, and the name must work after the `sklearn.experimental.enable_*` import. Remove the TYPE_CHECKING block only once the estimator leaves experimental.
applies: sklearn public subpackage __init__.py files that expose experimental estimators via __getattr__
